metadata.Entity and scope: DEMOCO; December 2025; USD; all 10 supplied PBC areas
metadata.Population or sample: Three material bank accounts; two reconciliations supplied; synthetic samples for other PBCs
metadata.Preparer and reviewer: Alex Morgan / Taylor Chen (fictional; payroll deliberately self-reviewed)
metadata.Source system: Fictional exports for the source-system categories in the PBC workbook
metadata.Extraction timestamp: Bank sources: 2026-01-08T10:00:00Z; nonbank sources: 2026-01-16T10:00:00Z; separate from browser capture
metadata.Completeness check: RESERVE-003 deliberately missing; all other sample populations described in source files
metadata.Accuracy and reconciliation check: OPERATING-001 balances; PAYROLL-002 has a deliberate USD 100 difference
metadata.Cut-off check: 31 December 2025; payroll reconciling item is 91 days old
metadata.Evidence lineage: Evidence IDs map to named JSON files; SHA-256 hashes computed over actual mock bytes
metadata.Exception status: Open: payroll difference, stale/unsupported item, self-review, missing reserve account, late leaver removal
metadata.Sensitive-data treatment: All amounts, identities, entities and records are fictional
metadata.Preparation and review dates: Bank prepared/reviewed 2026-01-06/07; nonbank prepared/reviewed 2026-01-14/15; simulated assessments 2026-01-17
metadata.Auditor cross-reference: DEMO-PBC-001 through DEMO-PBC-010; no real audit working paper
metadata.Final status: DEMONSTRATION ONLY; exceptions open; final reviewer signoff intentionally blank
